parameters.command:
=TITLE="{{ $json.jobTitles }}"
LOC="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.location }}"
MAX="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.maxJobs }}"
TIME="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.timeRange }}"

mkdir -p /data/n8n_linkedin/output

cd /data/n8n_linkedin/python && python3 jobs_scraper.py -k "$TITLE" -l "$LOC" -n $MAX -t $TIME 2>&1

case "$TIME" in
  "24h") SECS="86400" ;;
  "48h") SECS="172800" ;;
  *) SECS="172800" ;;
esac

FILE_TITLE=$(echo "$TITLE" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE_LOC=$(echo "$LOC" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE="/data/n8n_linkedin/python/${FILE_TITLE}__${FILE_LOC}_r${SECS}.json"

if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  cat "$FILE"
else
  echo '[]'
fi

=FILE="{{ $json.outputFile }}"
REC=$(echo '{{ $json.b64 }}' | base64 -d)
mkdir -p $(dirname "$FILE")
if [ -f "$FILE" ] && [ -s "$FILE" ]; then
  CUR=$(cat "$FILE")
  echo "${CUR%]},$REC]" > "$FILE"
else
  echo "[$REC]" > "$FILE"
fi
echo "Saved match"

=FILE="{{ $json.outputFile }}"
REC=$(echo '{{ $json.b64 }}' | base64 -d)
mkdir -p $(dirname "$FILE")
if [ -f "$FILE" ] && [ -s "$FILE" ]; then
  CUR=$(cat "$FILE")
  echo "${CUR%]},$REC]" > "$FILE"
else
  echo "[$REC]" > "$FILE"
fi
echo "Saved rejected"

parameters.content:
## LinkedIn Job Search v5

**IMPORTANT:** After import, manually connect:
1. Save Match → (drag line back to) Parse Jobs
2. Save Rejected → (drag line back to) Parse Jobs

This creates the loop to process all jobs.

**Config:** `/data/n8n_linkedin/config.json`
**Output:** `/data/n8n_linkedin/output/`
